name: moh_643_patient_list_template
description: MOH 643 patient list. One row per patient; test counts are summed on the line.

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t1.person_id AND pi.voided = 0 AND pi.identifier_type = 8 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(pn.given_name, ''), COALESCE(pn.middle_name, ''), COALESCE(pn.family_name, '')) FROM amrs.person_name pn WHERE pn.person_id = t1.person_id AND pn.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn.preferred DESC, pn.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.value SEPARATOR ', ') FROM amrs.person_attribute c WHERE c.person_id = t1.person_id AND c.voided = 0 AND c.person_attribute_type_id IN (10, 48))
